title: Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR) and Account Unlock
content: All NovaTech employees can reset their corporate Active Directory / Okta password via the Self-Service Password Portal at https://passwords.novatech.internal. If your account is locked due to multiple failed attempts, visit the portal, click 'Unlock Account', and complete verification via your registered Duo MFA mobile app or SMS code. title: Corporate VPN Configuration with GlobalProtect
content: Remote employees must connect to the corporate network using Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN. To install or configure: 1. Launch the GlobalProtect agent from your system tray or application folder. 2. Enter portal address 'vpn.novatech.com'. 3. Authenticate using your NovaTech Single Sign-On (SSO) credentials followed by Duo MFA push. GlobalProtect operates with split-tunneling enabled by default; corporate internal resources (staging, Jira, internal wikis) are routed through the VPN tunnel, while public internet traffic (Zoom, YouTube, web browsing) bypasses it. If you receive error 'Gateway Not Reachable', verify your local internet connection, restart the GlobalProtect service, and verify that port 443/IPSec is not blocked by your ISP.

title: Information Security Incident and Phishing Reporting
content: If you receive a suspicious email, SMS, or Slack message, or suspect your machine or credentials have been compromised: 1. Potential Credential Compromise / Malware: Immediately disconnect your computer from Wi-Fi/Ethernet, lock the device, and alert the Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) via emergency hotline +1-800-555-SIRT or email security-alert@novatech.com.

title: Annual Paid Time Off (PTO / Earned Leave) and Carry-Forward
content: Full-time regular employees accrue 18 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per calendar year, accrued at 1.5 days per completed month of service. Employees can carry forward a maximum of 5 unused PTO days into the following calendar year. Any additional accrued unused PTO days beyond the 5-day cap expire on March 31st of the new year without financial encashment, unless mandated otherwise by local statutory laws. PTO requests of 3 consecutive days or more must be submitted in the HR Workday Portal at least 2 weeks in advance and approved by your manager.

If taking 3 or more consecutive sick days, employees must provide a signed medical certificate from a licensed healthcare professional upon returning to work. Sick leave cannot be carried forward to the following calendar year and is non-encashable upon resignation.

title: Annual Performance Bonus and Variable Incentive Criteria
content: Annual performance bonuses are determined by a combination of overall company performance (Corporate Multiplier: 0% to 150%) and individual performance evaluation ratings (Individual Multiplier: 0% to 130%). Target bonus percentages are defined in your employment contract (typically 10% to 25% of annual base salary). Bonus payouts are processed in the March 31st payroll cycle following the annual review. To be eligible for payout, an employee must have joined prior to October 1st and remain actively employed on the payout date.

title: Equity, Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Stock Options Vesting
content: NovaTech equity grants (RSUs or Stock Options) are administered via Carta. Standard vesting schedule: A 4-year vesting timeline with a 1-year cliff. Specifically: 25% of total grant vests exactly on the 1-year anniversary of your Vesting Start Date. Following the 1-year cliff, the remaining 75% vests in equal quarterly increments (6.25% per quarter) over the subsequent 36 months. Quarterly vesting dates are March 15, June 15, September 15, and December 15. View grant letters and exercised shares at https://carta.com.

title: On-Call Compensation and Overtime Policy
content: Engineering and technical operations personnel assigned to primary production on-call rotation schedules receive dedicated on-call compensation: 1. Base On-Call Allowance: $350 per full week on primary on-call rotation ($175 for secondary backup), regardless of whether incidents occur. 2. Incident Response: If paged outside standard business hours for a P1/P0 production incident, engineers receive compensatory time off (Comp Off) equivalent to 1.5x time spent troubleshooting, rounded up to the nearest hour. Submit on-call tracking via PagerDuty monthly sync.

title: Commuter Benefits and Transit Pass Subsidies
content: Employees working from a regional physical office are eligible for pre-tax commuter benefits administered through Edenred. You can set aside up to the IRS monthly pre-tax limit (currently $315/month) for qualified public transportation (subway, train, commuter bus) and $315/month for qualified parking. Additionally, NovaTech provides a direct $50/month company transit subsidy for employees utilizing green public transit instead of driving single-occupancy vehicles. Enroll by the 10th of the prior month via Edenred portal.

title: Final Settlement and Severance Calculations
content: Upon voluntary resignation or involuntary termination, an employee's final settlement (Full & Final) is processed in accordance with local labor statutes. The final settlement encompasses: prorated salary up to the final working day, encashment of eligible accrued unused PTO days (capped at statutory maximums), reimbursement of approved outstanding Concur expense claims, and any deduction for unreturned company assets. Final settlement disbursements are issued via standard direct deposit within 30 days of the last working day.

title: Relocation Assistance and Moving Reimbursement Package
content: Employees hired into roles requiring physical relocation closer to a corporate hub may receive a lump-sum relocation package (typically $5,000 to $15,000 based on tier and household size), managed through our global mobility partner Cartus. Relocation packages cover moving van logistics, temporary housing for up to 30 days, and transit airfare. Relocation agreements include a standard 12-month clawback clause: if an employee voluntarily resigns within 12 months of relocation, a prorated portion of the relocation grant must be repaid to NovaTech.
